mapper.select: select case t.from_openid when #{openId} then 1 else 0 end as "type", t.from_openid "from_openid", t.openid "openid", to_char(t.created_date,'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') "created_date" from cmwa_wx_act_share_info t where t.from_openid = #{openId} or t.openid = #{openId}

select t1.type as "type",t1.from_openid as "from_openid",t1.openid as "openid" from (select case t.from_openid when #{openId} then 1 else 0 end as type, t.from_openid, t.openid, rownum rw from cmwa_wx_act_share_info t where t.from_openid = #{openId} or t.openid = #{openId} order by t.created_date desc) t1 where t1.rw <10;
